anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: || papyrus page 45. Continues Witte p.142 / PDF 146. ἀνέο<εσ>ιν as printed.

bible_refs.note: The true mother, Jerusalem above — possible.

choices.why: The land of sojourning as wet-nurse, not the true mother.

pass_a_gloss: For the sacrifice is ready upon salvation of those sojourning according to infancy of love of the nurse that has come to be for them, of the land that reared them — which nurse having they used as a mother, not knowing the true mother, having been reared with a letting-go of flesh for bodies and with this world sweeter for a time according to pleasure, held by ignorance of their fatherly world — being called Hebrews.
pass_b_english: For the sacrifice is ready for the salvation of those sojourning according to the infancy of love of the nurse that has come to be for them, of the land that reared them — which nurse they had and used as a mother, not knowing the true mother, having been reared with a letting-go of flesh for bodies and with this world, sweeter for a time according to pleasure, held by ignorance of their paternal world — being called Hebrews (Galatians 4:26) (Galatians 4:1–3).
source_text: Ἑτοίμη γὰρ ἡ θυσία ἐπὶ σωτηρίαν τῶν παροικούντων κατὰ νηπιότητα ἀγάπης τῆς αὐτοῖς γενομένης τιθηνοῦ τῆς ἐκθρεψάσης αὐτοὺς γῆς – ἥντινα τιθηνὸν ἐσχηκότες ὡς μητρὶ ἐχρῶντο ἀγνοοῦντες τὴν ἀληθινὴν μητέρα, σαρκὸς δ’ ἀνέο<εσ>ιν σώμασι καὶ προσ||καίρῳ καθ’ ἡδονὴν ἡδυτέρῳ κόσμῳ τούτῳ συντραφέντες ἀγνοίᾳ κρατηθέντες τοῦ αὐτῶν πατρικοῦ κόσμου – καλουμένων Ἑβραίων.
